verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since such a service could ship command-line tooling for programmatic filings or searches. The evidence pack shows only web portals, downloadable forms, live chat, mail and in-person options; no official CLI is documented. The DOR probe shows a JavaScript web app shell, not a command-line interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
